analyze.completeTip: Analysis complete! Copy DESIGN.md and give it to your AI coding agent.

analyze.replaceThemeDescription: A theme named “{{theme}}” already exists. Replacing it updates that saved theme and merges any older duplicate entries with the same name. Analysis history is retained.

pageCount.label: Pages to analyze
pageCount.help: Default: 3 (choose 1–5). Includes this URL and same-site pages; if fewer exist, only those are analyzed.

depth.label: Analysis depth
depth.standardHelp: Captures desktop and mobile sizes. Faster.

evidenceDetail.title: Evidence detail

designDna.title: AI design insights
designDna.managedNotice: This signed-in analysis may contain your account information. Nothing is sent to the configured AI until you choose "Start AI interpretation"; screenshots are not sent unless you enable that separately in Settings.
designDna.cancelledNotice: AI interpretation was cancelled; the extracted design data is unaffected.
designDna.fallbackNotice: AI interpretation was unavailable. The extracted design data and exports are unaffected.

statusDescription.not-configured: Set up an API key or a local AI CLI in Settings to generate design insights. Extraction and exports work fine without AI.
statusDescription.not-requested: This analysis only extracted design data; no AI interpretation was requested.
statusDescription.pending: The extracted result is ready to view while AI interpretation runs in the background.
statusDescription.cancelled: Cancelled. The extracted design data is unaffected.
statusDescription.complete: Every conclusion was verified against real page evidence.
statusDescription.partial: AI conclusions passed validation. Some fields were empty or lacked detail, but core design information is intact.
statusDescription.failed: The AI returned an unusable result. The extracted design data was not modified.
statusDescription.timeout: The AI model took too long to respond. Try again, switch to a faster model, or lower the reasoning effort in Settings.
statusDescription.skipped: You skipped AI interpretation for this analysis. The extracted design data and exports are unaffected.
statusDescription.unsupported: The configured engine cannot run design interpretation.

visionChoice.title: The current model cannot see screenshots
visionChoice.description: Switching to a model that accepts images gives a more accurate visual interpretation. You can also generate an interpretation from page structure only; the result is clearly labeled.

designDna.validationHelp: Renders the extracted rules on neutral sample UI and checks tokens, states, contrast, and layout one by one.

previewContent.title: Create a new item
previewContent.description: Review the information and confirm the next step.
previewContent.summary: A neutral content block for checking hierarchy, rhythm, and surface treatment.

profile-grounding.passed: Every preserve rule retains at least one validated evidence citation.
profile-grounding.failed: At least one preserve rule has no evidence citation.
profile-grounding.suggestion: Remove the unsupported rule or reinterpret it from additional evidence.

token-spacing.passed: All recipe gaps use extracted spacing tokens.
token-spacing.failed: The recipe contains an off-scale gap.
token-spacing.suggestion: Replace off-scale gaps with extracted spacing values.

rule-references.failed: At least one rule reference does not exist.
rule-references.suggestion: Remove references that are not present in the validated profile.

state-coverage.rule: State scenarios include focus and error surfaces
state-coverage.passed: The state recipe includes focus and error fields.
state-coverage.failed: The state recipe is missing focus or error coverage.
state-coverage.unknown: This scenario does not attempt full state validation.
state-coverage.suggestion: Add allowlisted focus and error field states to the state recipe.

text-contrast.rule: Primary text and surface colors meet WCAG AA contrast
text-contrast.passed: The inferred primary pair meets the 4.5:1 threshold.
text-contrast.failed: The inferred primary pair is below the 4.5:1 threshold.
text-contrast.unknown: A reliable primary text/surface token pair could not be identified.
text-contrast.suggestion: Choose a higher-contrast extracted foreground/surface pair.

horizontal-overflow.rule: Neutral validation recipes avoid fixed-width horizontal overflow
horizontal-overflow.passed: The allowlisted layout uses bounded responsive columns and no fixed width.
horizontal-overflow.failed: The recipe requests more than four columns.
horizontal-overflow.suggestion: Reduce the validation grid to four or fewer responsive columns.

reduced-motion.rule: The neutral validation recipe remains usable with reduced motion
reduced-motion.passed: The allowlisted recipe contains no required animation or time-dependent interaction.

overview.title: Extracted design facts
overview.evidenceOnlyDescription: Everything below was directly observed by the browser — screenshots, colors, typography, and page structure — with no AI guesswork.
overview.legacyTitle: This record has no page evidence
overview.legacyDescription: This analysis was saved before page evidence existed, so it has no screenshots or structure data. Its colors, typography, and exports still work.
overview.sectionCoverage: Identified sections cover {{percent}}% of the page
overview.statesPassive: {{count}} deduped interaction state patterns (hover, focus, active, disabled)
overview.statesPassiveObservations: {{count}} passive CSS state observations (no user action performed)
overview.statesPassiveTooltip: Passive states come from CSS declarations only — no clicks or input were performed. This describes how the data was captured, not a confidence level.
overview.statesResponsive: {{count}} layout differences found across screen sizes
overview.statesEmpty: No interaction states or screen-size differences were recorded.
overview.noLimitations: No capture limits in this analysis.

limitations.fewerPages: The site had fewer analyzable pages than requested ({{pages}} captured).
limitations.singleViewport: Only one screen size was captured, so layout changes across sizes could not be compared.
limitations.noSections: No clear page sections could be identified.
limitations.noActiveInteractions: Some interactions were not observed because they could not be triggered safely.
limitations.noInteractionStates: No interaction state changes (such as hover or focus styles) were captured.
limitations.noMedia: No major image or video regions were found on the captured pages.
limitations.noMediaClassification: The purpose of media regions could not be determined.
limitations.unknown: Some data could not be captured.

sessions.title: Website sign-ins
sessions.description: Used to access pages visible only after sign-in during analysis. View or remove website sign-ins saved by Imprint here.
sessions.notice: Signing in is not required: public and sign-in pages remain analyzable, but content available only after sign-in cannot be accessed. States stay in Imprint's isolated browser and never read or affect your everyday Chrome profile.
sessions.emptyDescription: A website appears here only after you choose to sign in during analysis and Imprint verifies it.
sessions.error: The saved sign-in could not be removed. Close any active sign-in browser and try again.

auth.requiredDescription: The target currently shows a sign-in page or blocking sign-in prompt. You can sign in with an isolated Imprint browser, or continue and analyze only the page that is currently visible.
auth.privacy: Imprint never reads your everyday Chrome profile. If you sign in, the session is saved only in a separate local browser profile for this website.
auth.loginWindowDescription: A separate Chrome window is open. Finish signing in there, then return to Imprint and continue.
auth.loginIncompleteTitle: Sign-in still appears to be required
auth.loginIncompleteDescription: The target page still shows a sign-in barrier. Finish the remaining steps in Chrome, then try continuing again.
auth.anonymousWarningDescription: This result only describes the sign-in page or prompt shown to signed-out visitors.

failure.title: Analysis stopped with an error
failure.description: The URL and any previous result have been kept. Review the actual error below, then retry when ready.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configure the AI engine and local data

ai.title: AI Engine Configuration
ai.description: Semantic analysis of design styles requires AI support. Choose how Imprint should connect:
ai.activeHint: Only this method is active. Switching methods keeps the other configuration saved but inactive.
ai.apiKeyIncomplete: Select a provider and enter an API Key to enable this method.
ai.agentCliIncomplete: Select an installed CLI to enable this method.
ai.modelHint: Leave blank to use Imprint's provider default. Set an exact model ID when your endpoint requires one.
ai.modelCatalogHint: Only current-generation models are listed. An older generation appears only when it is priced differently.
ai.reasoningEffortHint: Lower effort = faster and cheaper responses. Higher effort = deeper reasoning but slower.
ai.thinkingEnabledHint: When enabled, the model performs deeper chain-of-thought reasoning before responding. Improves quality significantly but increases latency and token usage.
ai.customVision: This custom model accepts image input
ai.customVisionHint: Enable only when the OpenAI-compatible endpoint and selected model support inline image input.
ai.visionConsent: Allow sending site screenshots to the AI
ai.visionConsentHint: Screenshots let the AI see the page's visual design, which noticeably improves interpretation. They are only sent to {{provider}} when you analyze public pages; signed-in page screenshots are never sent unless you enable that below.
ai.managedVisionConsent: Also allow screenshots from signed-in pages
ai.managedVisionConsentHint: Signed-in pages may show account or internal information in screenshots. When enabled, starting interpretation on a signed-in analysis may send a limited set of its screenshots to {{provider}}. You can revoke this at any time.
ai.agentCliStructuralHint: AI interpretation runs in an isolated temporary folder that is deleted afterwards. Note: whether the CLI uploads data to an external service depends on that CLI's own configuration — data may leave this machine.
ai.agentCliVisionConsent: Allow sending site screenshots to the CLI
ai.agentCliVisionConsentHint: Screenshots are attached as files for the selected CLI and noticeably improve interpretation quality. Whether they are uploaded to an external service depends on that CLI's own configuration.
ai.detectDescription: AI CLIs detected on this system
ai.detectHint: Detection runs when you first open this method and is reused for the current app session. Detection never selects a CLI. Use refresh after installing a new one.
ai.noCli: No supported AI CLI was detected

network.title: Network Proxy
network.proxyHint: Leave empty to auto-detect system proxy. Use for Clash/V2Ray/SSR proxies when TUN mode doesn't work.

data.title: Data Management
data.confirmClear: Clear all saved website themes and analysis records? Settings will be kept. This cannot be undone.
data.tip: The local data JSON archives saved themes and analyses, excludes API keys, and cannot currently be restored as a package. Runtime logs live in the logs folder — include them when reporting issues.
